annotations.description: Annotations added to the Velero and node-agent pods

defaultMaintenanceFrequency.description: Default maintenance frequency for backup repositories

podResources.description: Global maintenance job resources. A value of 0 is treated as unbounded

priorityClassName.description: The PriorityClass's name used for maintenance Job's pods.

loadAffinity.description: Maintenance job load affinity per backup repository

podResources.description: Maintenance job resources per backup repository. A value of 0 is treated as unbounded

bucket.description: Name of the storage bucket where backups should be stored

caCert.description: Content of the certificate used when verifying TLS connections to the storage

caCertRef.description: Reference to a Secret containing the CA certificate bundle to use when verifying TLS connections to the provider. The Secret must be in the same namespace as the BackupStorageLocation.

key.description: The key of the secret to select from.  Must be a valid secret key

name.description: The name of the secret in the pod's namespace to select from.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration fields. Refer to https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero-plugin-for-aws/blob/main/backupstoragelocation.md for AWS S3 and S3-compatible storage

credential.description: Content of the credentials for backup storage

prefix.description: Prefix under which all Velero data should be stored within the bucket

labels.description: Labels added to the Velero and node-agent pods

backupPVC.description: Config for backupPVC (intermediate PVC) of snapshot data movement

annotations.description: Annotations added to the backup PVC. Linked-clone feature is enabled by setting {csi.vsphere.volume/fast-provisioning: "true"} in the annotations.

perNodeConfig.description: Data path load concurrency per node

podResources.description: Resources for various types of pods launched by node-agent, i.e. data mover pods

priorityClassName.description: The PriorityClass's name used for the data mover pods.

restorePVC.description: Config for restorePVC (intermediate PVC) of generic restore

dataMoverPrepareTimeout.description: How long to wait for preparing a DataUpload/DataDownload

kubeletRootDir.description: kubelet mount path for nodes where running node-agent

nodeAgentDisableHostPath.description: Determines whether to disable hostPath volumes for node-agent

privileged.description: Use privileged mode for node-agent. Required to backup block devices

resources.description: Resources for node-agent pod. A value of 0 is treated as unbounded

priorityClassName.description: The PriorityClass's name used for Velero Deployment and node-agent DaemonSet pods.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the auto-created ServiceAccount

name.description: ServiceAccount set to the Velero and node-agent pods, users should create the ServiceAccount and the RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding before the installation. A default ServiceAccount/ClusterRoleBinding will be created automatically if leave the property empty.

disableInformerCache.description: Disable informer cache for Get calls on restore. With this enabled, it will speed up restore in cases where there are backup resources which already exist in the cluster, but for very large clusters this will increase velero memory usage.

garbageCollectionFrequency.description: How often the garbage collection runs for expired backups

itemBlockWorkerCount.description: Number of worker threads to process ItemBlocks

plugins.description: Plugin container images to install into the Velero Deployment. The AWS plugin is included by default, no need to specify it here

podVolumeOperationTimeout.description: How long to wait for pod volume operations to complete before timing out

resources.description: Resources for Velero pod. A value of 0 is treated as unbounded

restoreResourcePriorities.description: Desired order of resource restores, the priority list contains two parts which are split by "-" element. The resources before "-" element are restored first as high priorities, the resources after "-" element are restored last as low priorities, and any resource not in the list will be restored alphabetically between the high and low priorities.
